source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Exclude failed tests (do not add the below information to the consumer product performance report).
3. Review individual test data results, and determine if you are using the test method most sensitive to your fiber. If the test results show the following:
     - Tensile strength in tension load is the most sensitive test method.
     - Elongation in tension elongation is the most sensitive test method.
     - Puncture in displacement is the most sensitive test method.
     - Tear strength in tearing load is the most sensitive test method.
4. If the test was not the most sensitive test method, you must also test the most sensitive test method (per the 4 instructions above) and include the results of those tests in the consumer product performance report. 
5. Document the following in the instructions for your consumer product performance report:
     - Fabric description, including fiber content (14),
     - The test condition
